summary: APM feed s099_single is overloaded: 12.81 Gbps microbursts exceed the 10 Gbps tool port (128% capacity, 2 intervals). All other checks healthy. Immediate load balancing or slicing required to prevent drops.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker aggregates too much traffic to a single 10 Gbps APM port without load balancing. 1ms microbursts peak at 12.81 Gbps (128% of port capacity) across 2 intervals, exceeding the 80% safe threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will suffer buffer overruns and random drops during bursts, causing incomplete flow/transaction records, inaccurate latency and Apdex calculations, and missed performance anomalies despite needing both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute aggregated traffic across 2+ APM ports to keep per-port utilization below 80% and absorb microbursts without drops. Preserves both directions APM requires; since APM needs_full_payload=false, add slicing to 512-1024B as complementary reduction if needed.
